name: page get
description: Get a Confluence Cloud page by ID, with its storage-format body

name: page find
description: Find a Confluence Cloud page by space key and exact title

name: page list
description: List pages in a Confluence Cloud space (consider --output-file for large results)

name: page children
description: Get the direct children of a Confluence Cloud page

name: page history
description: Get the versions of a Confluence Cloud page

name: page search
description: Search Confluence Cloud with CQL

name: page create
description: Create a new Confluence Cloud page

name: page update
description: Update a Confluence Cloud page (fetches the current version automatically)

name: page delete
description: Delete a Confluence Cloud page (moves it to the trash; does not purge it)

name: page comments
description: List footer comments on a Confluence Cloud page

name: page comment
description: Add a footer comment to a Confluence Cloud page

name: page labels
description: Get labels on a Confluence Cloud page

name: page label
description: Add labels to a Confluence Cloud page

name: page unlabel
description: Remove a label from a Confluence Cloud page

name: space list
description: List Confluence Cloud spaces

name: space get
description: Get a Confluence Cloud space by key

name: page attachments
description: List attachments on a Confluence Cloud page

name: page attach
description: Upload a file as an attachment to a Confluence Cloud page

name: attachment download
description: Download a Confluence Cloud attachment to .toil/ (or --dir)

name: attachment delete
description: Delete a Confluence Cloud attachment by its ID (moves it to the trash; does not purge it)
